elements.quote: The result of this SRMA showed the overall pooled prevalence of SSI following cesarean section in Ethiopia was 11.13% with a 95% CI: (9.29, 12.97%), which is much higher than the global prevalence of 5.63% [40]. This result is consistent with a study conducted in Rwanda which is 10.9% [14]. However, this was lower than the study conducted in China [15], Jordan [41] and Ekiti state, Nigeria [13] reported 23.3%, 14.4% and 16.01% respectively. ... elements.quote: Therefore, evidence based practice before, during and after labor and delivery should be practiced to avoid prolonged duration of labor, chorioamnionitis and repeated vaginal examination.
